title: 第2章 天降异能
content_zh:
散发着刺鼻药水味的白色病房里，季枫躺在病床上，还处于昏迷的状态。

实际上，此时在他的脑海中，却是不断的有声音响起。

“生物电流刺激启动，寻找融合契机……”

“精神波动正常，神经末梢连接完毕……”

“宿主大脑中枢神经融合完毕……”

“融合完毕，数据库开始启动……叮！”

“宿主身体强化程序开始启动……”

不知道过了多长时间，季枫缓缓从昏迷中醒来，映入眼帘的，是一张布满了泪水的脸庞。

“妈……”季枫下意识的叫了一声，旋即便反应过来，猛然坐起，吃惊的看着周围的环境，“妈，这是医院？我怎么会在这里？”

坐在病床旁的，正是季枫的母亲，肖素梅。

“枫儿，你终于醒了？”见到季枫做起来，肖素梅顿时惊喜异常，赶紧抹去脸上的泪水，拉起儿子的手问道：“枫儿，你觉得好些了吗？”

季枫下意识的点点头，疑惑的问道：“妈，你怎么了，发生什么事了？”

肖素梅抹着眼泪，说道：“你这孩子，刚开学第一天就逃课，还因为中暑昏倒在了街上，要不是有好心人把你送来，妈可就要失去你这个儿子了！”

季枫的脸色顿时惨白，他回想起来了，自己之所以会逃课离开学校，只是不想继续在那个地方待下去。

他生怕再从胡雪慧的口中听到‘私生子’这三个字，再加上分手的痛心，这才失魂落魄的出了学校。

看到儿子的脸色苍白，肖素梅顿时关切的说道：“枫儿，你的脸色怎么这么难看，是不是哪里不舒服？”

季枫赶紧拉住了要去叫医生的母亲，看到母亲那焦急的神色，他心中忍不住一酸，无比愧疚的说道：“妈，都是我不好，让你担心了。我向你保证，以后再也不会逃课，会认真的学习，不再让你操心了！”

“好！好！”肖素梅见儿子这么懂事，又忍不住高兴的掉下泪来，“妈知道，枫儿是最懂事的！”

季枫心中讽刺的一笑，如果自己懂事，就不会忘记含辛茹苦的母亲，更不会忘记母亲是靠着每天贩卖一些蔬菜来供自己读书，而去一心迷在胡雪慧的身上。

自己简直就是一个禽兽不如的混蛋！季枫无比痛恨以前的自己！

季枫的母亲肖素梅的老家是在农村，因为未婚先孕，肖素梅被父母赶出了家门，无家可归。被人认为是伤风败俗的坏女人，亲戚朋友的讥笑与讽刺，世态炎凉的冷漠，让肖素梅在农村呆不下去了，只能带着身孕流落到县城。

幸好，在好心人的接济下，肖素梅租了一间廉价的房子，将季枫生了下来。

在季枫小的时候，肖素梅只能背着季枫，白天帮别人家看孩子，顺便带着季枫。到了晚上，就去附近的垃圾场，淘一些能卖钱的废品，就这样艰难度日。

等到季枫的年龄稍微大了一些，肖素梅这才轻松了一些，靠着邻居的帮忙，买了一辆脚踏三轮车，做了小菜贩子，虽然赚的钱不多，但是除掉季枫的学费，他们母子二人的生活倒也勉强过得去。

季枫更是早早的懂事，放学后便来到县城的菜市场，帮着母亲卖菜，倒也帮了肖素梅不少忙。

可是，自从和胡雪慧开始交往之后，季枫便每次借口学习任务重，课余时间去菜市场帮母亲的次数越来越少，绝大多数时间，都与胡雪慧在一起。

现在想起来，季枫心中忍不住一阵绞痛，自己怎么就瞎了眼，放着含辛茹苦的母亲不去疼，反而迷上了那个势利的胡雪慧？

“妈，对不起！”季枫认真的说道，“从今往后，我不会再让你受苦，我一定要让你过上好日子，要让那些曾经嘲笑你，看不起你的人，都来巴结你，逢迎你，我要让你有我这个儿子而感到骄傲！”

此时的季枫，在看到母亲的泪水之后，终于醒悟了，新生了！

这是他新生之后，做出的第一个郑重的承诺，为了含辛茹苦的母亲！

“好，好！”肖素梅猛然把儿子抱在怀里，眼泪簌簌的往下掉。

这十几年来的苦楚与艰难，终于在这一刻得到了回报，肖素梅觉得满足极了。哪怕生活再苦，但是有这样一个懂事孝顺的儿子，她也觉得值了！

依偎在母亲怀中，季枫心中坚定的对自己说道：“季枫，从今天开始，忘记胡雪慧，做一个全新的你，因为，你还有母亲需要孝顺！”

母子二人相拥，病房中弥漫着浓浓的温馨与亲情。

但是就在这个时候，病房的门‘砰’的一声被人大力推开了。

母子二人猛然转头看去，只见一个肥胖的护士满脸不屑的走了进来，冷漠的说道：“肖素梅，你们三天的住院期限还有二十分钟就到期了，要是还想住的话，就去交钱，不然的话，就立刻收拾东西离开！”

肖素梅赶紧站起来，说道：“这位护士，我儿子这才刚醒，身体还很虚弱，能不能缓一缓，最多一个小时我们就离开，您看可以吗？”

“哼！”那肥胖的护士不屑的说道：“缓一缓？我们这里可是正规的医院，不是乡下的小诊所，缓一缓可以啊，去交钱！住不起就不要住，装什么大款！”

肖素梅被说的满脸通红，又气又怒，却又说不出什么来。想起儿子的身体还很虚弱，她只能暗咬银牙，道：“我交钱！”

“妈！”季枫脸色阴沉的叫住了肖素梅，冷冷的看着那个护士，猛然从病床上下来，冷冷的问道：“我们的病房还有二十分钟才到期，是吗？”

“没错！”那护士不屑的说道：“怎么，看你的样子还想打我啊？哼！”

“好，真好！”季枫怒极反笑，冷冷的说道：“既然我们的病房还有二十分钟，那么，在这二十分钟之内，这间病房还是属于我们的，对吗？”

“你想说什么？姑奶奶没时间跟你穷墨迹，要走赶紧走！”那护士不耐烦的说道。

“滚出去！”季枫脸色阴沉的说道。

“你说什么？”那肥胖的护士一时间没有反应过来。

“我说，让你，滚！出！去！”季枫一字一字的说道，“在这二十分钟内，我们还是这间病房的主人，现在，我让你滚出去！”

“你……！”那护士愤怒的瞪着季枫，却无从反驳，因为在这二十分钟之内，季枫的确有权利支配这间病房，只要不超出医院的规定！

最终，肥胖的护士只能狠狠的说道：“等到二十分钟之后，如果你们再不离开，姑奶奶就让保安把你们丢出去！哼！”
content_en:
In the white ward that smelled of pungent potion, Ji Feng was lying on the bed, still in a coma.

In fact, at this time, there were sounds constantly ringing in his mind.

"Bioelectric stimulation starts, looking for opportunities for fusion..."

"The mental fluctuations are normal and the nerve endings are connected..."

"The central nervous system of the host brain has been fused..."

"The fusion is completed, the database starts... Ding!"

"The host body strengthening program begins..."

I don't know how long it took, Ji Feng slowly woke up from his coma, and what he saw was a face full of tears.

"Mom..." Ji Feng yelled subconsciously, and immediately reacted, sitting up suddenly and looking at the surrounding environment in surprise, "Mom, this is a hospital? Why am I here?"

Sitting next to the hospital bed was Ji Feng's mother, Xiao Sumei.

"Feng'er, are you finally awake?" Seeing Ji Feng doing it, Xiao Sumei was immediately overjoyed. She quickly wiped away the tears on her face, took her son's hand and asked, "Feng'er, do you feel better?"

Ji Feng nodded subconsciously and asked doubtfully: "Mom, what's wrong with you? What happened?"

Xiao Sumei wiped away her tears and said, "You kid, you skipped class on the first day of school, and you even fainted on the street because of heatstroke. If some kind-hearted people hadn't sent you here, my mother would have lost your son!"

Ji Feng's face suddenly turned pale. He recalled that the reason why he skipped classes and left school was because he didn't want to stay there any longer.

He was afraid of hearing the word 'illegitimate child' from Hu Xuehui again, and coupled with the pain of breaking up, he left the school in despair.

Seeing her son's pale face, Xiao Sumei immediately said with concern: "Feng'er, why do you look so ugly? Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere?"

Ji Feng quickly grabbed his mother who was about to call the doctor. When he saw his mother's anxious look, he couldn't help but feel sour in his heart. He said with great guilt: "Mom, it's all my fault for making you worry. I promise you that I will never skip classes again in the future, I will study seriously, and I won't let you worry anymore!"

"Okay! Okay!" Seeing how sensible her son was, Xiao Sumei couldn't help but shed tears of joy, "Mom knows, Feng'er is the most sensible!"

Ji Feng smiled sarcastically in his heart. If he was sensible, he would not forget his mother who had gone through so much hardship, let alone her mother who sold some vegetables every day to support her studies, but was obsessed with Hu Xuehui.

I am simply a bastard worse than a beast!Ji Feng hated his former self so much!

Ji Feng's mother Xiao Sumei's hometown is in the countryside. Because she became pregnant out of wedlock, Xiao Sumei was kicked out of the house by her parents and became homeless.Being considered a bad woman immoral, ridiculed and ridiculed by relatives and friends, and indifferent to the harsh world, Xiao Sumei could no longer stay in the countryside, so she could only live in the county town with her pregnancy.

Fortunately, with the help of kind people, Xiao Sumei rented a cheap house and gave birth to Ji Feng.

When Ji Feng was young, Xiao Sumei could only carry Ji Feng on her back, take care of other people's children during the day, and take Ji Feng with her at the same time.At night, I go to the nearby garbage dump to find some scraps that can be sold for money, and I live like this.

When Ji Feng got a little older, Xiao Sumei felt a little more relaxed. With the help of neighbors, she bought a tricycle and became a vegetable vendor. Although she didn't make much money, excluding Ji Feng's tuition fees, the life of mother and son was barely enough.

Ji Feng became sensible early on. After school, he went to the vegetable market in the county town to help his mother sell vegetables, which also helped Xiao Sumei a lot.

However, since he started dating Hu Xuehui, Ji Feng used to excuse his heavy study load every time and went to the vegetable market to help his mother less and less in his spare time. He spent most of his time with Hu Xuehui.

Thinking about it now, Ji Feng couldn't help but feel a twinge of pain in his heart. How could he be so blind that he ignored the pain of his mother who endured all the hardships and instead fell in love with that snobbish Hu Xuehui?

"Mom, I'm sorry!" Ji Feng said seriously, "From now on, I will not let you suffer anymore. I must let you live a good life. I will make those who once laughed at you and looked down on you come to flatter you and flatter you. I will make you proud to have my son!"

At this time, after seeing his mother's tears, Ji Feng finally woke up and was reborn!

This was the first solemn promise he made after his rebirth, for his mother who had endured so much hardship!

"Okay, okay!" Xiao Sumei suddenly hugged her son in her arms, tears falling down.

The pain and hardship for more than ten years finally paid off at this moment, and Xiao Sumei felt extremely satisfied.No matter how hard life is, having such a sensible and filial son makes her feel that it is worth it!

Nestling in his mother's arms, Ji Feng said firmly to himself: "Ji Feng, from today on, forget Hu Xuehui and become a new you, because you still have a mother to be filial to!"

The mother and son hugged each other, and the ward was filled with deep warmth and family affection.

But at this moment, the door of the ward was pushed open with a loud bang.

The mother and son suddenly turned their heads and saw a fat nurse walking in with disdain and said coldly: "Xiao Sumei, your three-day hospitalization period will expire in twenty minutes. If you still want to stay, go and pay, otherwise, pack your things and leave immediately!"

Xiao Sumei stood up quickly and said, "Nurse, my son has just woken up and is still very weak. Can you please take a moment and we will leave in one hour at most? Do you think that's okay?"

"Hmph!" the fat nurse said disdainfully: "Wait a minute? We are a regular hospital here, not a small clinic in the countryside. Just wait a minute. Go and pay! Don't live here if you can't afford it. Why are you pretending to be rich!"

Xiao Sumei's face turned red when she was told that, she was angry and angry, but she couldn't say anything.Remembering that her son was still very weak, she could only bite her teeth secretly and said, "I'll pay!"

"Mom!" Ji Feng called Xiao Sumei with a gloomy face, looked at the nurse coldly, suddenly got off the hospital bed, and asked coldly: "Our ward will not expire in twenty minutes, right?"

"That's right!" the nurse said disdainfully: "Why, you still want to hit me after looking at you? Humph!"

"Okay, great!" Ji Feng laughed angrily and said coldly: "Since our ward still has twenty minutes, then within these twenty minutes, this ward still belongs to us, right?"

"What do you want to say? My aunt doesn't have time to talk to you. If you want to leave, leave quickly!" the nurse said impatiently.

"Get out!" Ji Feng said with a gloomy face.

"What did you say?" The fat nurse didn't respond for a moment.

"I told you to get out! Get out! Go!" Ji Feng said word by word, "In these twenty minutes, we are still the owners of this ward. Now, I tell you to get out!"

"You...!" The nurse glared at Ji Feng angrily, but had no way to refute, because within these twenty minutes, Ji Feng did have the right to control this ward, as long as it did not exceed the hospital's regulations!

In the end, the obese nurse could only say harshly: "If you don't leave after twenty minutes, my aunt will ask the security guards to throw you out! Humph!"
